title: A number describer
description:
Describe a whole number in words.

```
describe(42)    ->  "42 is positive, even and has 2 digits"
describe(-7)    ->  "-7 is negative, odd and has 1 digit"
describe(0)     ->  "0 is zero, even and has 1 digit"
```
hints: `n % 2 === 0` is even (for negatives too, since `-7 % 2` is `-1`, not `0`).
`String(Math.abs(n)).length` counts the digits. A ternary picks the word: `digits === 1 ? "digit" : "digits"`.
requirements: Say whether it is positive, negative or zero, even or odd, and how many digits it has (the minus sign is not a digit).
Use `Number.isInteger`; anything else returns `"Not a whole number"`.
stretch: Also say whether the number is prime.
